up: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism rows including canonical SMILES, substrate compound name, parent compound name, metabolic conversion, and pathway key. Use the substrate join path metabolism.substrate_record_id -> compound_records.record_id -> compound_structures.molregno. The substrate_compound_name must come from compound_records.compound_name. The parent_compound_name must come from molecule_dictionary.pref_name reached through molecule_hierarchy.parent_molregno. Do not substitute molecule_dictionary.pref_name for substrate_compound_name. Do not deduplicate rows; keep the first 200 rows from that join result. Return exactly canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, and pathway_key.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr_sub.compound_name AS substrate_compound_name,
  md_parent.pref_name AS parent_compound_name,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key
FROM metabolism m
JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr_sub.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON cr_sub.molregno = mh.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md_parent ON mh.parent_molregno = md_parent.molregno
LIMIT 200;
